explanations: watch() registers a wrapper function (listener) on the bus, but the stop function passes the caller's onUpdate to bus.off. EventEmitter removes listeners by identity, and onUpdate was never registered, so off() does nothing. Every finished or reassigned trip leaves its listener on the bus. Each listener keeps its session, socket and pickup reachable, so the heap grows, and every ping runs more and more stale callbacks, including ones that push the old driver's position to a reassigned rider. The watcher count is kept separately and is decremented correctly, which is why the dashboard looked normal. Passing the same listener reference that was given to bus.on() actually unsubscribes it.
